data.title: 公众号营销
data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":1},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"公众号营销"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"justify"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"微信公众号营销是基于微信公众平台生态，"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"以类似公众号文章内容的形式在包括公众号文章、订阅号消息列表等营销资源位进行展示的内容营销。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"justify"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"通过整合亿级优质用户流量，利用专业数据处理算法，公众号营销为客户提供了一个成本可控、效益可观、精准定向的互联网内容营销平台。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"营销形态"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"公众号营销包含丰富多元的营销形态，你可点击感兴趣的营销形态，进一步了解详情。"}]},{"type":"format","attrs":{"id":"formats_mlrAq","dataSource":[{"id":"formatItem_RkNSS","name":"订阅号消息列表营销","description":["原生自然","海量曝光","深度浏览"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/vgliauyp_ebb87ce75793b1e3e0039ebfef798d07.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2811&pid=7653","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_G9fPo","name":"公众号互选内容营销","description":["内容定制","细致解读","传播力强"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/c3r7e1tk_d7bbf276cbbc8782a3c76561d22de47f.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=1569&pid=4685","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_JaoCy","name":"文章底部营销","description":["海量曝光","样式丰富","深度阅读人群"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/ntv82s8k_99188791f68161a8f39d30644ab0695d.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=1567&pid=6834","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_UNFj-","name":"文章中部营销","description":["阅读场景","视觉聚焦","高曝光率"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/77307mkg_286ddc948bd1e67b25fdb758f368e1e2.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=1570&pid=4687","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_ZdwAI","name":"视频贴片营销","description":["原生自然","沉浸体验","声影结合"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/ou4ewfbt_6bc4a5f07b42282cc18e16948d17f36d.png","videoSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t3/zt41b31e_ec010216550fb2ebb3a15e0e5ce21143.mp4"},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=1568&pid=4673","tag":"不展示"}]}},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"相关帮助"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":3},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"1.售卖策略"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"公众号底部营销支持按曝光排期购买、按曝光竞价购买和按点击竞价购买；公众号文中营销支持曝光排期和按点击竞价购买；公众号视频贴片营销支持曝光竞价购买；公众号互选内容营销按文章收费，文章价格由自主决定。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"link_Ru49W","src":"https://support.e.qq.com/detail?cid=4608&pid=9363","text":"详细了解售卖策略","rightIcon":"arrow-forward"}}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":3},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"2.行业准入"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"公众号营销当前已开放多个一级行业类目，符合腾讯营销准入行业要求，即可投放公众号营销。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"link_Ru49W","src":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2085&pid=6217","text":"详细准入行业要求","rightIcon":"arrow-forward"}}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":3},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"3.人群定向"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"公众号营销支持按照地域、性别年龄、设备类型、兴趣行为定向标签、再营销等属性进行定向。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"link_Ru49W","src":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=3213&pid=9284","text":"详细了解人群定向","rightIcon":"arrow-forward"}}]}]}
